title: Each trader's servant gets one paper capital pool and one paper RuntimeBinding on first paper use
problem_register_class: RC4 — Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader (SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 T7)

owner_paths_exercised: Capital owner: GET /api/capital-pools/{pool_id}, POST /api/capital-pools, GET /api/bindings/{binding_id}, POST /api/bindings, POST /api/bindings/{binding_id}/activate via PersonaProvisioningCoordinator.ensure_chain_paper_capital
Runtime-Manager owner: RuntimeManagerClient.list_by_pool, RuntimeManagerClient.deploy, RuntimeManagerClient.get with dynamic bearer auth from PAPER-RUNTIME-MANAGER-DYNAMIC-BEARER-20261125

ac4_hosted_proof.note: Worker environment has no direct write access to hosted dev before this branch merges and deploys. After dev deploy switches to a release containing PAPER-TRADER-BOOK-PROVISION-20261127, invoke POST /bff/agora/servant/paper-book/ensure and GET /bff/agora/servant/paper-book for the dev trader account to record the hosted CapitalPool ID and RuntimeBinding ID.

runtime_budget.cadence: on-demand only (first paper use per trader servant persona; GET-first idempotent no-op on subsequent calls)
runtime_budget.hosted_scale_size_and_count: 1 CapitalPool row (~1 KB), 1 PersonaCapitalBinding row (~1 KB), and 1 RuntimeBinding row (~1.5 KB) per trader account in the existing Capital and Runtime-Manager stores (<350 KB total at 100 traders)
runtime_budget.growth_per_day: 0 B/day steady state after initial trader enrollment (idempotent GET-first readback writes 0 bytes when pool, capital binding, and active RuntimeBinding already exist; persona metadata write is skipped when paper_book summary is unchanged)
runtime_budget.cap_and_cleanup: Bounded 1:1 to trader servant personas (CapitalPool.single_runtime_enforced=true); retired through the existing binding-before-pool retirement path (retire_chain_paper_capital and RuntimeManagerClient.retire)

residual_findings.summary: Base dev (84b002124) had 13 /bff/agora/persona-lab/* routes present in services/control-plane/bff/contract_snapshots/backend_routes_manifest.json that had not been written into docs/bff/contract_snapshots/route-diff-baseline.json (508 vs 495 backend_missing_frontend). Regenerating backend_routes_manifest.json and route-diff-baseline.json via scripts/bff_route_manifest_backend.py and scripts/bff_route_diff.py --write-baseline synchronized the baseline alongside the 3 new paper-book routes.

Two tests in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_servant_production_write_owner.py fail on base dev when PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL is unset (/bff/management/persona-fleet returns 422 on unconfigured Evolution reader) and because cross-tenant personas are now omitted from excluded[] in participants:eligible rather than returned with reason tenant_mismatch.
